overview.title: 2025 Quarterback Fantasy Analysis
overview.summary: The quarterback landscape in 2025 is dominated by dual-threat players who provide elite floors and ceilings. Mobile quarterbacks continue to separate themselves from pocket passers through rushing production and goal-line opportunities.
keyInsights: Dual-threat QBs dominate the top-5 probability rankings
Schedule strength plays a major role in QB1 finishes
Goal-line rushing creates significant scoring floors

analysis.headline: Elite dual-threat QB with highest floor/ceiling combination and proven track record in Ravens' optimized system.
strengths: League-leading rushing upside for QB position
Elite play-action efficiency with Derrick Henry
concerns: Age 28 entering prime injury risk years
Potential decreased rushing attempts for longevity
keyFactors: Ravens' commitment to designed QB runs

analysis.headline: Premier QB with unmatched ceiling but difficult playoff schedule creates championship path concerns.
strengths: Elite arm strength and deep ball accuracy
